title: Road to bigger shoulders
summary: He wants shoulders slightly bigger than his chest. His front delts are developed, side delts moderate and rear delts lacking, so rear then side delts are priorities, trained with overhead presses, high-rep front raises and fairly heavy rear-delt accessories.

claims.claim: He wants his shoulders slightly bigger than his chest.
His front delts are well developed, side delts somewhat, rear delts lacking: rear delts are priority one and side delts priority two.
Even if shoulders never needed focus, healthy shoulders are very important for pressing, so he trains them hard.
His shoulder work: lots of overhead pressing, high-rep front raises for the front delt, and rear-delt accessories with relatively high weight.

exercises.name: Rear delt accessories
exercises.why: rear delts are his weakest head
